name: Pau D'Arco with Selenium
headline: Pau D'Arco with Selenium
description: Pau d'arco bark powder with selenium and vitamin C helps strengthen immunity by stimulating the body's own defences. Selenium and vitamin C, two strong antioxidants, help protect cells from harmful internal and external effects.
howToUse: Adults – 1-2 capsules a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Pau d'arco bark 500 mg, vitamin C 60 mg, selenium 30 mcg, excipients.
